analyses.outcome_group: Sensitivity of computer-aided diabetic retinopathy detection

rules: Select one held-out image-level 2x2 diagnostic table per source.
Select only an expert-referenced DR-positive (NPDR/PDR) versus normal contrast with TP, FP, FN, and TN.
Use counts, not potentially mislabeled sensitivity/specificity columns or review forest values.

analyses.outcome_group: Specificity of computer-aided diabetic retinopathy detection

rules: Apply the same complete image-level 2x2 eligibility rules as the paired sensitivity analysis.
Preserve source-reported numeric values and metadata without altering them.

method_selection_policy: After identifying eligible independent evidence, select and justify a synthesis approach from the study data. The participant package does not prescribe a computation method.
